# Case: ssd-mixed-parameter-bindings

## Requirement or fault

One system must carry both an inline `ParameterValues` set and a parameter
binding whose `source="external_values.ssv"` is unresolved when the SSD is read
standalone, and must be resolved when the archive layer sees the sibling file.

## Level

component (SSD codec and facade), system (archive-layer binding resolution).

## Input provenance

Hand-authored here, SSP1 `SystemStructureDescription` 1.0. The external binding
points at `ssv-external-parameter-set/input.ssv`; the archive tests write it
under the arcname `external_values.ssv` that the document names.

## Independent oracle

`src/pyssp_standard/schema/SSP1/SystemStructureDescription.xsd` through
`Ssp1SsdSchemaValidator` in
`tests/ssp1/codec/test_ssd_xml_codec.py::test_mixed_fixture_is_hand_authored_and_schema_valid`.

## Comparison

Parsed structure: binding `source`, absent `parameter_set` standalone, resolved
`parameter_set` and parameter values after archive resolution.

## Update policy

Reviewed with a codec or archive change that alters binding semantics; never
auto-updated and never regenerated by the library.

## What this case proves

That external parameter sources are resolved from the archive rather than
tolerated as dead attributes. Without it, only inline parameter sets are
exercised.
